title: The deep's swell
lede: A wave of swell crosses the deep's water, pushing the stars and motes right, then they ease back.
head: 34e9972acaa212ce37befa50f10660b6f759b324

items.title: A swell crosses the deep
items.what: One band at a time rolls across, mixed strengths; stars and motes are pushed right and ease back.
